posts.author: DogsUnderstand
posts.body:
Gobble through a surreal maze-chase adventure packed with oddball characters
and playful JRPG elements. A love letter to the software RPG Maker 2003.
Features:
Pick Up and Play – Easy to learn, instantly fun, and packed with fast-paced, arcade-style action moments.
Secrets for the Skilled – A linear adventure full of hidden routes and secret challenges for expert players.
Iconic Characters Await – Chat with a cast of quirky, memorable personalities in polished, charming environments.
Expect the Unexpected – Every area hides a surprise; curiosity is always rewarded.
Fewer Deaths, Better Endings – Survive the journey to improve your odds of unlocking the best possible outcome.

STORY
Spoiler
Noël was sunbathing outside on his lounge chair while Francisco was bringing refreshments,
when suddenly…
…Holes appeared in the sky……And candies started raining out of the holes!
They looked so delicious…
Noël gobbled… and gobbled… Until there were no candy left.
Once the candies vanished, a magic door appeared and transported Noël
toward unknown territories…
Where could those candies be leading Noël? For what mysterious reason?? And who is behind it all???
Take control of Noël and discover for yourself by exploring the strange world of
GOBBLE FANTASY 2003
!
WORLD
Spoiler
Welcome to the Nice Peace Kingdom!
A trail of candies is guiding Noël through this land where magic and technology collide.
Many dangers await on the road, but also friendly creatures ready to help!
